stem: What key idea about Forrest Fenn is supported by the details in paragraphs 4 and 5 of the selection "A Modern-Day Treasure Hunt"?

options.label: A
options.text: Forrest Fenn is hopeful that his treasure will never be found by anyone.

options.label: B
options.text: Forrest Fenn is overwhelmed by the attention he has received over the years.

options.label: C
options.text: Forrest Fenn is firm in his decision to keep the location of his treasure secret.

options.label: D
options.text: Forrest Fenn is untrusting of the people closest to him.
